system_name: Fraud Detection System for Digital Payments and Banking Transactions

peas.environment: Digital banking and payment gateway infrastructure processing real-time transaction streams from ATMs, POS terminals, mobile apps, and web portals

observability.justification: The system cannot directly observe the true intent of the user or whether a card was physically stolen.

agents.justification: The system operates against adaptive adversarial agents (fraudsters) who change strategies over time.

determinism.justification: Identical transaction features can result in either a legitimate or fraudulent outcome depending on hidden factors.

episodicity.justification: Each decision depends on prior account history, and current actions affect future evaluations.

dynamics.justification: Fraud patterns and user behavior continuously evolve while the system operates.

discreteness.justification: Transaction amounts, timestamps, coordinates, and risk scores are continuous-valued.
